parameters.name: Addr
parameters.description: A list of addresses in the address pool.

sub_parameters.name: AttributeInfo
sub_parameters.description:
The source region of the address. This parameter is a JSON string.

- LineCode: The line code of the source region. This parameter is deprecated. Use lineCodes instead.

- lineCodes: A list of line codes for the source regions.

- lineCodeRectifyType: The type of line code rectification. Default value: AUTO. Valid values:

  - NO\_NEED: No rectification is required.

  - RECTIFIED: The line code is rectified.

  - AUTO: The line code is automatically rectified.

sub_parameters.name: Mode
sub_parameters.description:
The mode. Valid values:

- SMART: Smart return

- ONLINE: Always online

- OFFLINE: Always offline

parameters.name: AddrPoolId
parameters.description: The ID of the address pool. For more information, see [DescribeDnsGtmInstanceAddressPools](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstanceaddresspools).

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: LbaStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

- ALL\_RR: Returns all addresses.

- RATIO: Returns addresses by weight.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the address pool.
